title: Flax & Chia Dark Peanut Butter Bites
subtitle: Recipe Formulation Sheet

meta.baseTargetScale: 12 Mini Cups (~270 g Target Batch Footprint)

scalingPrinciple: Lock Item A.01 at 100.0% to serve as the mathematical baseline weight. All subsequent component percentages are calculated relative to that baseline. Volumetric values map to the current baseline target scale and must be dynamically scaled via weight calculations for larger yields.

rows.name: Natural Smooth Peanut Butter
rows.role: Core foundational substrate; provides fat and protein structure.

rows.name: 85% Dark Chocolate
rows.role: Hard shell barrier; cacao bitter profile and low sugar loading.

rows.name: Fine Golden Flaxseed Meal
rows.role: Dry binder; lipid absorber; insoluble/soluble fiber structural matrix.

rows.name: Melted Coconut Oil / Butter
rows.role: Thermal fat modifier; smooth melt point adjustment.

rows.name: Whole Chia Seeds
rows.role: Hydrocolloid seed matrix; tactile crisp pop texture.

rows.name: Pure Vanilla Extract
rows.role: Aromatic enhancer and bitterness masking agent.

rows.name: Maldon Flaky Sea Salt
rows.role: Sodium accent; ionic contrast on top shell surface.

mise.label: Golden Flax & Seed Integration (B.02, B.04)
mise.text: Ensure golden flaxseed meal is used (rather than brown) to avoid sharp astringent tannins. In a stainless mixing bowl, combine fine golden flaxseed meal (B.02), chia seeds (B.04), natural peanut butter (A.01), vanilla extract (B.05), and 1.5 tbsp (~16 g) of melted coconut oil (B.03).

mise.label: Hydration & Binding Wait State
mise.text: Allow the seed and peanut butter base to rest at ambient room temperature (70°F/21°C) for 3 to 5 minutes. Soluble fiber mucilage in the flax and chia will bind free oil, transforming the liquid paste into a pliable dough-like matrix.

mise.label: Shell Temper Preparation (B.01, B.03)
mise.text: Chop 85% dark chocolate (B.01) into uniform 5 mm pieces. Place in a heatproof bowl with 1 tsp (~4 g) of coconut oil (B.03).

execution.name: Core Matrix Base Portioning
execution.text: Line a 12-cup mini muffin tin with parchment paper cups. Portion approximately 13–14 g of hydrated peanut-seed dough into each liner. Press down gently with a clean utensil to form flat, uniform foundation discs.

execution.name: Chocolate Shell Liquefaction
execution.text: Set the dark chocolate bowl over a double boiler of gently simmering water. Whisk slowly until smooth, glossy, and fully fluid (working temp 88–90°F / 31–32°C).

execution.name: Encapsulation & Leveling
execution.text: Evenly spoon ~7–8 g of melted chocolate over each peanut butter disc base. Tap the tray firmly against the counter surface twice to release trapped air bubbles and smooth the top layer.

execution.name: Top Finish & Thermal Setting
execution.text: Allow chocolate to cool for 2 minutes, then top each cup with flaky sea salt (C.01). Transfer the tray to the freezer to achieve a crisp shell snap and firm fudge core.

qc.target: Dense, fudge-like interior free of grittiness; sharp snap on outer dark chocolate shell with subtle seed pop.
Glossy, un-bloomed dark cap with evenly distributed sea salt crystals.
Deep roasted peanut and cocoa synergy; subtle natural sweetness without artificial aftertaste.

directive: Store finished mini cups in an airtight container under refrigeration (40°F/4°C) or freezing (0°F/-18°C) to maintain lipid network integrity and snap profile.
